issues.display_title: Issue #539: Trail Post Payload Enhancements (Scene URLs & Required Thumbnail)
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Trail Post Payload Enhancements (Scene URLs & Required Thumbnail)

Context & References

  • Parent / Previous Task: GoThruMedia/panorra-api-new#532 (Publish trails)
  • Task Specification: docs/tasks/2026-10-07/trail_post_payload_enhancements.md
  • Commits:
    • ca7cdfa1a93f04e14cfc9c4d09d2730ff2473e24 — feat: update trail URLs to include scene identifiers and enhance validation for different tours
    • 75a370cc786ce497a8b9ff3ae1cc57dbfd4db355 — feat: add thumbnail support for trail posts and enhance validation for missing thumbnails

1. Summary of Changes

1.1 Trail Point Scene Identifiers & Tour Integrity

File: src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/trail_validation.go

  • Normalized URL Deduplication:
    Changed deduplication from a composite prefix + ":" + tourKey map to a normalized URL map: 
    normalizedURL := strings.TrimRight(pt.URL, "/")
if seenURLs[normalizedURL] {
    return nil, nil, &TrailValidationError{
        Input:   fmt.Sprintf("trail.points[%d].url", i),
        Message: "Duplicate tour URL",
    }
}
seenURLs[normalizedURL] = true
  • Same-Tour Constraint Across All Points:
    Captured firstTourKey from the first point and verified every subsequent point shares the same tour identifier: 
    if i == 0 {
    firstPrefix = prefix
    firstTourKey = tourKey
} else {
    if prefix != firstPrefix {
        return nil, nil, &TrailValidationError{
            Input:   fmt.Sprintf("trail.points[%d].url", i),
            Message: "All tours must use the same prefix (F1 or G1)",
        }
    }
    if tourKey != firstTourKey {
        return nil, nil, &TrailValidationError{
            Input:   fmt.Sprintf("trail.points[%d].url", i),
            Message: "All trail points must belong to the same tour",
        }
    }
}

1.2 Mandatory Raw url_thumbnail Handling

File: src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostCompleteEmbed.go

  • Early Publish Validation:
    Enforced non-empty url_thumbnail during publish mode alongside location validation: 
    if isPublishMode {
    // Location validation ...

    // Early thumbnail validation on publish
    if strings.TrimSpace(c.FormValue("url_thumbnail")) == "" {
        return Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 400, fiber.ErrBadRequest.Message, "Thumbnail is required", "url_thumbnail")
    }
}
  • Bypass S3 / MinIO Re-Upload (Direct Raw Passthrough):
    For trails, bypassed saveImage = true and PostFunctions.ProcessThumbnail. The raw string from c.FormValue("url_thumbnail") is assigned directly to thumbnailPanorama: 
    imageUrl := c.FormValue("url_thumbnail")
var thumbnailPanorama, pathThumbnail string
var saveImage = false

if isPost == "trail" {
    thumbnailPanorama = imageUrl
    saveImage = false
} else {
    // Existing S3/MinIO upload logic for other embed types...
}
  • Safe Old Asset Deletion Guard:
    Added pathPostOld != "" guard before calling os.Remove(pathPostOld): 
    if thumbnailPostOld != "" && pathPostOld != "" {
    if err := os.Remove(pathPostOld); err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
        return Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 500, fiber.ErrInternalServerError.Message, "Failed to delete file")
    }
    // ... MinIO file deletion ...
}

1.3 Bruno API Collection Synchronization

  • api-collection/Panorra API Post/Trail/Publish Trail.yml: Added url_thumbnail form field and updated trail point URLs with scene identifiers.
  • api-collection/Panorra API Post/Trail/Edit Trail.yml: Updated trail point URLs with scene identifiers (/46562264p, /46562366p).

2. Testing & Verification

Executed full unit test suites:

go test -count=1 ./src/Action/V1/Posts ./src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions

Test Results

  • TestCompleteEmbedTrail_DifferentTours: PASS
  • TestSameTourMultiplePoints_UserPayload: PASS
  • TestCompleteEmbedTrail_Publish_MissingThumbnail_Returns400: PASS
  • TestCompleteEmbedTrail_Publish_Success: PASS
  • TestCompleteEmbedTrail_SaveDraft_WithThumbnail_Success: PASS
  • Non-trail embed regression tests: PASS

Context & References

  • Parent / Previous Task: GoThruMedia/panorra-api-new#532 (Publish trails)
  • Related Commits:
    • ca7cdfa1a93f04e14cfc9c4d09d2730ff2473e24 — feat: update trail URLs to include scene identifiers and enhance validation for different tours
    • 75a370cc786ce497a8b9ff3ae1cc57dbfd4db355 — feat: add thumbnail support for trail posts and enhance validation for missing thumbnails

1. Problem Statement

Following the initial release of the trail posts feature (#532), two critical payload issues were identified during frontend-backend integration:

  1. Scene Identifier URLs and Tour Key Collision Bug:

    • In the initial implementation, ParseTourURL assumed trail point URLs were top-level tour links (e.g., https://tourmkr.com/F1<tourKey>), and duplicate checks only verified the prefix:tourKey identifier.
    • Tourmkr clients provide full scene-targeted URLs (e.g., https://tourmkr.com/F1<tourKey>/<sceneId>). Because multiple trail points represent distinct scenes within the same virtual tour, the old check incorrectly flagged valid multi-scene trails as duplicate tours.
    • Additionally, there was no enforcement verifying that all trail points share the same parent tour (tourKey), allowing payloads that mistakenly mix different tours into a single trail.

  2. Empty Thumbnail on Trail Post Publish:

    • In POST /posts/complete-embed, standard embed posts re-upload thumbnails to MinIO/S3 via saveImage = true.
    • For trails, thumbnail images are pre-hosted on Tourmkr/GoThru CDN. Re-processing/uploading is unnecessary, but because trails had no explicit thumbnail handling, postUpdates["thumbnail"] was left empty upon publish.
    • Trail posts require a single, mandatory url_thumbnail payload on publish (action=publish) that must be stored directly as a raw link into posts.thumbnail.

2. Scope

  1. Trail Tour URL Parsing & Same-Tour Integrity:

    • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/trail_validation.go:
      • Update ParseAndValidateTrail to deduplicate by full normalized URL (strings.TrimRight(pt.URL, "/")).
      • Enforce that all points in a trail belong to the same parent virtual tour (tourKey) and use identical tour prefixes (F1 or G1).

  2. Raw url_thumbnail Form Payload for Trail Posts:

    • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostCompleteEmbed.go:
      • Enforce url_thumbnail as required when isPost == "trail" and action == "publish"; return 400 Bad Request if empty.
      • For trail posts, set saveImage = false and assign the raw url_thumbnail value directly to thumbnailPanorama, persisting it into postUpdates["thumbnail"].
      • Guard old file removal with pathPostOld != "" to avoid filesystem errors on posts without local files.

  3. API Collection & Documentation:

    • Update api-collection/Panorra API Post/Trail/Publish Trail.yml and Edit Trail.yml with valid scene URLs and url_thumbnail.

  4. Automated Unit Testing:

    • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/trail_validation_test.go:
      • Test rejection of points from different tours (TestDifferentTours_Rejected).
      • Test acceptance of multi-scene points from the same tour (TestSameTourMultiplePoints_UserPayload).
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostCompleteEmbed_test.go:
      • Test rejection of missing url_thumbnail on publish (TestCompleteEmbedTrail_Publish_MissingThumbnail_Returns400).
      • Test successful persistence of raw url_thumbnail on publish (TestCompleteEmbedTrail_Publish_Success).
      • Test draft creation with url_thumbnail (TestCompleteEmbedTrail_SaveDraft_WithThumbnail_Success).

3. API Contract Updates

Endpoint

POST /posts/complete-embed (multipart/form-data)

Form Data Fields

Field Type Required Description
url_thumbnail string Yes (when action=publish) Raw thumbnail URL provided by the client (e.g., https://cdn.example.com/thumb1.jpg).
trail string (JSON) Yes Serialized JSON containing trail metrics and points.
trail.points[].url string Yes Valid Tourmkr scene URL (e.g., https://tourmkr.com/F1ueDlT23s/46562264p). Must share the same tourKey.

Error Responses

  • Missing Thumbnail on Publish (400 Bad Request): 
    {
  "statusCode": 400,
  "data": {
    "status": "Bad Request",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Thumbnail is required",
      "input": "url_thumbnail"
    }
  }
}
  • Conflicting Tours Across Points (400 Bad Request): 
    {
  "statusCode": 400,
  "data": {
    "status": "Bad Request",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "All trail points must belong to the same tour",
      "input": "trail.points[1].url"
    }
  }
}

4. Acceptance Criteria

  • Trail points accept valid Tourmkr URLs with scene identifiers (e.g., https://tourmkr.com/F1a1b2c3/46562264p).
  • Point deduplication checks the normalized full URL.
  • Payloads with points from different tours are rejected with 400 Bad Request ("All trail points must belong to the same tour").
  • Publishing a trail without url_thumbnail returns 400 Bad Request ("Thumbnail is required").
  • Publishing a trail with url_thumbnail stores the raw URL directly in posts.thumbnail without triggering MinIO/S3 upload.
  • Draft trails can be saved with or without url_thumbnail.
  • All automated tests pass with 100% success.
